about: Model and effort per gauntlet role. The orchestrator passes them as the Agent tool's model and effort parameters. Rules: Sonnet and Opus only, so model must be sonnet or opus (a full id of those families, such as claude-opus-5-5, reads as its family); a competitor on opus runs at medium effort or lower, so the judges (opus high) stay stronger. init stops on anything else. effort is low, medium, high, xhigh or max. A role may name another role instead of its own setup (swap_judge = judge). init --models mixed (the default) keeps the judge roles from this file and gives half the competitors opus medium and half sonnet high.
